steps.title: OTLP ingest
steps.detail: Services send OpenTelemetry over gRPC on a Unix socket.

steps.title: Normalize
steps.detail: Fields are renamed to a compact internal schema.

steps.title: Correlate
steps.detail: Trace IDs are joined with adjacent log windows to build a timeline.

steps.title: Compress
steps.detail: The joined stream is zstd-compressed in 1s frames.

steps.title: Emit
steps.detail: Frames are shipped to any Loki-compatible backend.
